edges.description: Reproduces the progenitor cell-cycle stall and the reduced SOX2/ASCL1 pioneer-site chromatin accessibility that this node describes.
edges.limitations: The model is an engineered early loss of BAF53a in mouse cortex, not the heterozygous missense/splice ACTL6A variants of patients, and mouse corticogenesis lacks the human-specific outer-subventricular-zone progenitor biology; it tests the mechanism rather than the human allelic state.
edges.source: Early BAF53a loss, developing mouse cortex (Braun 2021)

edges.description: Shows that reduced npBAF subunit dosage impairs neural-progenitor proliferation, the process behind the impaired-neurogenesis node.
edges.limitations: A general npBAF-dosage model across subunit genes rather than an ACTL6A-specific allele, and the reported severe outcome is neural-tube closure failure in mouse, not the human neurodevelopmental phenotype; it supports npBAF essentiality rather than the human allelic effect.
